subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow Anthropic-native web_search provider now, and what explicit opt-in, security, billing, and replay policy should gate Anthropic-hosted search?
rationale: The feature gap is clear, but the implementation adds provider-specific config, credential reuse, hosted web access, and transcript/session semantics that automation should not choose by default.

options.title: Design gated provider
options.body: Accept the feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broad server-tools design
options.body: Defer the narrow web_search provider until the broader Anthropic server-tools issue defines one policy for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and server-result handling.

options.title: Decline hosted search for now
options.body: Keep managed web-search providers as the supported path and document that Anthropic-hosted search is not currently planned.

recommendation.title: Design gated provider
recommendation.body: Accept the feature only as an explicit Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with documented security, billing, fallback, and replay behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent current-line history across the Anthropic manifest, registration, and transport/plugin boundary touched by the decision.
